info.title: Pexafy API
info.summary: Semantic search over a catalogue of freely licensed stock photography.
info.description:
Search runs on meaning rather than keywords, so queries read like sentences and filters narrow what the ranking already found.

Every response is an envelope: `success`, then `data`, then `pagination` on the list endpoints and `meta` everywhere. Failures use the same envelope with an `error` object whose `code` is stable across versions. Branch on the code, never on the message.

Enums marked `x-extensible-enum` grow between releases. Parse them as open strings; a client whose type is a closed set will fail the day a value is added.

tags.name: collections
tags.description: Saved sets, owned by an API key.

get.description:
Ranking is semantic, not keyword based, so a full sentence outranks a pile of nouns: 'two people hiking on a ridge at dawn' carries the relationships between the words and 'hiking dawn people' throws them away.

Filters are applied after the semantic match, which means a narrow filter on a broad query returns fewer results than the same filter on a narrow query. There is no total count and no page number; follow pagination.next_cursor.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What you are looking for, in words.

parameters.name: color_name
parameters.description: Restrict to one dominant colour. The API filters on a single colour; passing several is rejected rather than silently using the last one.

parameters.name: color_hex
parameters.description: Restrict to photos near one hex colour, used with color_tolerance.

parameters.name: color_tolerance
parameters.description: How far from color_hex a photo may sit, in the same units as the colour distance the indexer stores.

parameters.name: orientation
parameters.description: One or more orientations. Repeat the parameter or pass a comma separated list.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Restrict to one or more upstream libraries.

parameters.name: license_type
parameters.description: Restrict to one or more licence families.

parameters.name: photographer
parameters.description: Restrict to one photographer, by username.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Results per page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Hard ceiling on results across all pages of this query.

parameters.name: score_threshold
parameters.description: Drop results whose relevance score is below this. Search is semantic, so every query returns something; this is how you decide it returned nothing useful.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from pagination.next_cursor. Cursors are tied to the query that produced them and expire; treat them as single use.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma separated list of Photo fields to return. Trims the payload, does not change ranking.

parameters.name: after_date
parameters.description: Only photos uploaded on or after this date.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Ordering. Defaults to relevance.

X-Request-Id.description: Echoed in error payloads; quote it in a support request.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Calls left in the current window.

post.summary: Search photos by handing over an image
post.description:
The image is embedded and matched against the same vector space as a text query, so the two are interchangeable as far as ranking is concerned. The image is not stored.

Send either a file or a URL, not both. Anything over 10 MB is rejected before it reaches the encoder.

get.description: Counters are updated on write and may lag a call or two behind under load. Do not use them to decide whether the next request will succeed; use the 429 and the Retry-After header.

apiKey.description: Send the key as a bearer token. Keys carry scopes; a read scoped key gets a 403 on anything under /collections.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Every failure uses this shape, whatever the status code.

code.description: Machine readable and stable across versions. Branch on this, not on the message. The set is extensible: treat an unrecognised code as a generic failure of its status class.

field.description: Which parameter was rejected, when the failure is about one.

Pagination.description: Cursor paging. There is no total count: the result set is a ranked stream and counting it would cost more than returning it.

Orientation.description: Extensible: new orientations may be added.

Source.description: Upstream library. Extensible: this list grows as libraries are indexed, so parse it as an open string.

PhotoUrls.description: The same image at five widths. Pick the smallest one that fits; the CDN charges you nothing for it but the upstream library counts a view either way.

Attribution.description: Credit line, ready to drop into a page. Most upstream licences require it even when they do not require a link.

photo_id.description: UUIDv7. Sortable by creation time, which is why it is not an integer.

alt_description.description: Short text for an alt attribute. Null for a large part of the catalogue; fall back to description, then to source_description, then to nothing rather than to the filename.

relevance_score.description: Only present on search results. Comparable within one response and not across responses: the scores are normalised per query.

Facet.description: One allowed value of a filter, with how much of the catalogue it covers. Read these rather than hard coding the lists.

CollectionInput.description: What a client may set on a collection. Deliberately not the same component as Collection: sharing one would make every added response field an edit to the request contract as well.

Usage.description: Quota counters for the calling key's account.

searches_limit.description: Null on plans with no ceiling.
